glossary.nearest_defender_m: Average distance in metres from the ball to the nearest defender while the team does not have it. Smaller means the team closes the ball down quickly; larger means it has stopped pressing.
glossary.players_near_ball: Average number of the team's outfield players within 8 metres of the ball while out of possession.
glossary.pressures_per_min: Pressure events per minute: how often defenders close down the ball carrier.
glossary.ppda: Passes allowed per defensive action in the opponent's build-up zone. Lower means more aggressive pressing; higher means the team has stopped pressing.
glossary.front_sprints: Sprints (25 km/h or faster for at least one second) by the front-line attackers in the window.
glossary.high_regains: Times the team won the ball back in the opposition's final third in the window.
glossary.progressive_passes: Completed passes that move the ball at least 10 metres toward goal.
glossary.final_third_entries: Times the team moved the ball into the final third by pass or carry.
glossary.xt: Expected threat added: the value gained by moving the ball into more dangerous areas, plus shot quality.
glossary.possession_share: Share of the ball in the window.
glossary.chaos_index: 0-100 score for how chaotic play is: many turnovers and duels, short possessions, long balls. 50 is a typical five minutes of this league; low means orderly control.

explanation.why: Nearest defender in Northbridge's half: 6.7 m to 9.8 m. Pressures per minute 1.9 to 0.9, 53% fewer. But their threat is down (xT 0.06 to 0.04) against the deeper block.
explanation.so_what: Harbour can't keep the press going, so Northbridge now have more time on the ball. Even so, Harbour's deeper block is limiting the danger.

es.what: El Harbour ha dejado de presionar
es.why: Defensor más cercano al balón en campo del Northbridge: de 6,7 m a 9,8 m. Presiones por minuto de 1,9 a 0,9, un 53% menos. Pero su amenaza baja (xT de 0,06 a 0,04) ante el bloque más bajo.
es.so_what: El Harbour ya no aguanta la presión, así que el Northbridge tiene más tiempo con el balón. Aun así, el bloque más bajo del Harbour limita el peligro.

claims.text: Defensor más cercano al balón en campo del Northbridge: de 6,7 m a 9,8 m.
Presiones por minuto de 1,9 a 0,9, un 53% menos.
Pero su amenaza baja (xT de 0,06 a 0,04) ante el bloque más bajo.

caveats: No todos los indicadores coinciden: sprints de la línea de ataque, pases progresivos, amenaza creada, posesión se movieron en sentido contrario.

tr.why: Northbridge yarı sahasında topa en yakın savunmacı 6,7 m iken 9,8 m oldu. Dakikadaki baskı sayısı 1,9 iken 0,9 oldu (yüzde 53 düşüş). Ancak derin blok karşısında tehdit düştü (xT 0,06 iken 0,04 oldu).
tr.so_what: Harbour baskıyı sürdüremiyor; Northbridge artık topla daha rahat oynuyor. Yine de Harbour geriye çekilerek tehlikeyi sınırlıyor.

claims.text: Northbridge yarı sahasında topa en yakın savunmacı 6,7 m iken 9,8 m oldu.
Dakikadaki baskı sayısı 1,9 iken 0,9 oldu (yüzde 53 düşüş).
Ancak derin blok karşısında tehdit düştü (xT 0,06 iken 0,04 oldu).

caveats: Tüm göstergeler aynı yönde değil: hücum hattı sprintleri, ileriye paslar, üretilen tehdit, topa sahip olma ters yönde hareket etti.

glossary.nearest_defender_m: Average distance in metres from the ball to the nearest defender while the team does not have it. Smaller means the team closes the ball down quickly; larger means it has stopped pressing.
glossary.players_near_ball: Average number of the team's outfield players within 8 metres of the ball while out of possession.
glossary.pressures_per_min: Pressure events per minute: how often defenders close down the ball carrier.
glossary.ppda: Passes allowed per defensive action in the opponent's build-up zone. Lower means more aggressive pressing; higher means the team has stopped pressing.
glossary.front_sprints: Sprints (25 km/h or faster for at least one second) by the front-line attackers in the window.
glossary.high_regains: Times the team won the ball back in the opposition's final third in the window.
glossary.progressive_passes: Completed passes that move the ball at least 10 metres toward goal.
glossary.final_third_entries: Times the team moved the ball into the final third by pass or carry.
glossary.xt: Expected threat added: the value gained by moving the ball into more dangerous areas, plus shot quality.
glossary.possession_share: Share of the ball in the window.
glossary.chaos_index: 0-100 score for how chaotic play is: many turnovers and duels, short possessions, long balls. 50 is a typical five minutes of this league; low means orderly control.
glossary.last_chance_xg: Expected goals of the single best shot the team took in the window.
